RagShortTexts: Thoroughbred horses are prizes in rodeos and can also be purchased at high prices from horse dealers.

Variants.Content: Thoroughbred horses are extremely fast and valuable war horses that occasionally appear as the top prizes in rodeos and may be obtained from a few well-informed horse dealers. It is known for its unparalleled sprint speed, but riding it requires considerable riding skills and a rather sensitive temperament.

Thoroughbred horses are so fast that they can occasionally be seen as the first prize at imperial athletic competitions. But if you know some well-connected horse dealers, you can get one by paying a lot of money in advance. But this thing requires a lot of riding skills, and not just any noble young master can ride it well.

The thoroughbred horse in my stable was not won in the arena. I spent a large sum of dinars to buy it from a businessman who specialized in famous horses. That day he opened the tent mysteriously, and I fell in love with him at first sight. The greatest ability of this horse is that it is fast - not just fast, but so fast that it makes people's hearts beat faster. But apart from being fast, there is nothing particularly surprising about it. It is also extremely sensitive and will get upset if the feeding is even slightly wrong.

It is most honorable to win a thoroughbred horse at a rodeo, but you can also buy it directly from those horse dealers with great magic. But no matter which way, the cost is high. This horse is even more expensive to raise. The cost of fine grain alone is equivalent to the annual rations of an ordinary family.

Thoroughbred horses have also appeared in our Vlandia, usually as the grand prize at rodeos, or secretly traded at the horse market in Palawind. Its speed is a big advantage, and the opponent on a thoroughbred horse is the most difficult to deal with in a jousting competition - he will be in front of you before you know it. But after a race, the horse has to slow down for a long time.

We in Vlandia also have thoroughbred horses, which can occasionally be seen at rodeos. But rather than fighting tooth and nail to win, I prefer to buy from a trustworthy horse dealer. But to be honest, apart from being very fast, it is not much better than our good horse from Vlandia.

There were also purebred horses in the desert. They were either prizes brought from the north in athletic competitions or smuggled in by transnational caravans. It is still very fast on the sand dunes, but its endurance is ultimately not as good as our Nahasavi horse.

The speed of a thoroughbred horse is respectable, running like a gazelle on the prairie. But it is too delicate and cannot keep up with our pace when traveling long distances. If you really want one, try your luck at the rodeo, or buy one from the horse dealers from the west at a high price.

Thoroughbred horses are not practical in our north. They cannot run fast on snow and are afraid of the cold. Occasionally, it would be used as a prize in competitive competitions in the south, or some unsighted businessmen would transport it to the north to sell it, but most of the time it would be lost in their hands.

Thoroughbred horses cannot perform well in the woods. Its speed is useless in the dense forest, and it is too easily frightened. We would rather have a local horse that is familiar with the jungle than spend a lot of money on one or go to the arena and fight to the death.

Thoroughbred? If you are lucky, you can win it in the competition. If you are unlucky but have enough dinars, you can also buy it from some horse dealers who specialize in high-end goods. But remember, this horse has a fierce temperament, and anyone who is not good at riding is looking for death if he rides on it.

Thoroughbred horses require riders to have solid riding skills. It is too sensitive. If the reins are pulled too hard, it will get angry. If the reins are pulled too lightly, it will not listen at all. But if you are good at riding, it will be a sharp knife that can cut through the enemy formation on the battlefield.

Thoroughbred horses are top-notch goods that can be circulated in Calradia’s famous horse circulation system. It exists not only as an honorary prize in competitive competitions, but also as a semi-public trade through a few high-level horse dealers. Its core value lies in its explosive speed, but its demanding riding skills and other less prominent characteristics make its actual value slightly lower than those of top horses with both speed and endurance.
